transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: Okay, let's get started. Hardware program review. I'll go in order. Nora, did you want to kick off with the round of updates?

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Yes. To restate, the ask is where manufacturing stands for DVT. 1. Pelvis plates are in the machining queue. 2. Leg housings are through first article. 3. The hand pulleys are the one open item I'm worried about.

transcript.speaker: p-sofia
transcript.text: On the pulleys, we're waiting on a revised drawing from our side. I'll have it out tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Thanks, Sofia. That clears it.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Lukas, structures?

transcript.speaker: p-lukas
transcript.text: pelvis plates ok. torso frame welds are inspected, two need rework

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Two out of how many?

transcript.speaker: p-lukas
transcript.text: twelve

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Okay, that's not terrible. Keep me posted.

transcript.speaker: p-farah
transcript.text: Electrical status. 1. The driver boards are back from the second spin and passing bring-up. 2. The harness drawings are about eighty percent done. 3. We still have the current sense offset issue, but the new gate resistor values help.

transcript.speaker: p-mei
transcript.text: To add on controls, the offset is what's holding the torque loop tuning. I'd like to rerun on the new boards this week.

transcript.speaker: p-farah
transcript.text: Fine by me. I'll hand over two boards.

transcript.speaker: p-arjun
transcript.text: um for actuators, the hip stage is good, the knee stage had gear noise, tomas is looking at it. i think we'll know nxt wk

transcript.speaker: p-omar
transcript.text: Is the gear noise something that moves the date? I think probably not, but not 100% sure.

transcript.speaker: p-arjun
transcript.text: prob not, no

transcript.speaker: p-priya
transcript.text: Legs. Status: 1. Ankle is in good shape. 2. The hip yaw yoke is the long pole. 3. Drop test is scheduled but depends on the yoke. I'd like to protect that test.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: The drop rig is ready. I just need the legs.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: On supply, the yoke vendor is promising something. I'll get a firm date and report back at the next review.

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: One schedule change to flag. Actuator DVT build moved from 9/29 to 10/1. Everything downstream shifts a couple of days.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: A couple of days is fine, but I want to see the updated chart.

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: Yes. I'll send it out today.

transcript.speaker: p-omar
transcript.text: Does that touch the investor demo? i think it doesn't but i'll check

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: I'll confirm that too.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: For test, the gantry fixture is ready except for one alignment check. Life test is going well.

transcript.speaker: p-lukas
transcript.text: ok

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Anything else? Okay, thanks everyone, let's keep it moving.
